title: cryptogramma crispa var. acrostichoides
intro: Cryptogramma crispa var. acrostichoides, commonly known as Rock Bristle Fern, is a perennial plant species in the family Adiantaceae. It is native to the western regions of North America, where it thrives in shaded, moist environments. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Rock Bristle Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and potential anti-cancer properties.
